name: a dark log panel stacks behind the detail view
looks: A dark, code-styled log panel sits tilted, lines of raw calls scrolling past. A lighter detail card slides in front of it at its own offset tilt, breaking the same run down into billing, run details and a coloured trace timeline underneath.
build: Both panels share one perspective and tilt family (ui-tilt-card); the dark log panel's lines type/scroll on in mono (terminal-type-on mechanic); the lighter detail card enters on a spring, offset in front, its trace bars growing from a baseline on a short uneven stagger.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick under the log's scroll, a whoosh as the detail card settles in front.
prompt: Hold a dark, code-styled log panel tilted in the back with raw calls scrolling past in mono, then slide a lighter detail card in front of it at its own offset tilt, breaking the same activity down into a short trace timeline, so the raw record and its readable summary sit stacked together.
